questions.stem: Raised floors in a data center primarily protect against:

choices.B: Water damage from flooding or plumbing leaks

questions.explanation: Raised floors elevate equipment above floor level, protecting against water from flooding or plumbing failures.

choices.C: Surge protection and short-term battery power for graceful shutdown or generator startup

questions.explanation: A UPS provides immediate battery backup for short-term power loss, typically minutes, enabling graceful shutdown or bridging time until a generator starts.

questions.stem: The MOST appropriate fire suppression for a server room is:
questions.explanation: Clean agent gas systems suppress fires without water or residue, leaving no damage to electronic equipment.

questions.stem: ASHRAE recommended data center temperature range is:
questions.explanation: ASHRAE recommends 18–27°C inlet temperature. Temperatures outside this range increase hardware failure rates.

choices.C: Cooling efficiency by directing hot exhaust away from equipment intakes

questions.explanation: Alternating rack orientation directs cold air to equipment intakes and captures hot exhaust for removal, significantly improving cooling efficiency.

questions.stem: The MOST important control for preventing data loss during a multi-day power outage is:

choices.B: Diesel generator with automatic transfer switch

questions.explanation: A diesel generator provides hours or days of backup power. The automatic transfer switch detects outages and switches power within seconds.

questions.stem: Humidity above 60% in a data center primarily risks:

choices.C: Condensation forming on equipment causing short circuits

questions.explanation: High humidity risks condensation on cold components causing short circuits and corrosion. ESD risk is the opposite, it occurs at low humidity.

questions.stem: Which sensor detects water leaks under raised data center floors?
questions.explanation: Leak detection cables detect moisture under raised floors from plumbing or HVAC failures, triggering alerts before significant damage occurs.

choices.B: Direct integration with fire suppression activation
choices.D: Earlier detection of combustion particles before smoke is visible

questions.explanation: VESDA actively draws air samples and detects combustion particles at far lower concentrations than ionisation or optical detectors.

choices.A: One additional unit beyond minimum capacity, a spare available if any unit fails
choices.C: Cooling powered by one backup generator
choices.D: One unit shared between adjacent data centers

questions.explanation: N+1 means one spare beyond the minimum needed. If any unit fails, the spare maintains full capacity without service interruption.
